A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] '''masseuse''' crewed aboard the ''[[Uwana Buyer]]'', staffing the on board spa. A medical student, [[Gender/Legends|she]] worked her way through school with the money she earned. When called upon, she also served as the ship's [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]].
